# Security metrics

<!-- Generated by scripts/release_metrics.py at each release. -->

For OpenClear 1.30.0, released 2026-10-23: part of the due-diligence pack ([third-party risk](tprm.md)). Each release's notes on GitHub carry the same figures for that release.

- **ASVS 5.0:** 214 of 242 applicable requirements met (88%), 8 partly, 5 not met, 15 the service provider's ([crosswalk](https://github.com/chaffed/OpenClear/blob/main/docs/compliance/asvs.md)).
- **Advisories fixed:** none.
- **Dependencies:** 109 pinned at runtime; their releases' median age is 53 days; 21 are over a year old; 19 have a newer release (Dependabot and the weekly lock refresh propose them; one with a known vulnerability fails the build).
- **SBOM:** [openclear-1.30.0.cdx.json](https://github.com/chaffed/OpenClear/releases/download/v1.30.0/openclear-1.30.0.cdx.json) (CycloneDX).

Every change also passes CodeQL, Bandit, gitleaks, `pip-audit` and an OWASP ZAP baseline scan; ZAP's active scan runs weekly. How vulnerabilities are reported and how fast they're fixed: [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
